notes: Skill-gate extends skill-creator with Context Concise Principles and change-based verification. IDs 1-3 retain the original instruction-review regressions; IDs 4-6 exercise bundled script/config regression and capability-impact selection. IDs 8-9 cover document-level editing and lifecycle routing without an initial edit. Use skill-creator fresh old/revised evaluation, grader and viewer; grade.py and run-converted.sh remain historical supporting tools for IDs 1-3, not authoritative graders for new cases.

evals.name: rationale-swap
assertions: Overall verdict is ITERATE (not bare ACCEPT)
Flags the swapped anecdote/metric (the ~8× / 2026-08-02 sentence) as rationale to delete or reject
Rejects the dangling reference (the new step 4 citing a value this edit removed) by name

evals.name: generalize
assertions: Overall verdict is ITERATE (not bare ACCEPT)
Identifies the incident-narrative sentence (no-color/retries/2026-09-03) as should-be-generalized, with the why belonging in the commit message or design doc
Keeps the deterministic check (git diff / migrations/ planned-files) as load-bearing specificity, not as a thing to generalize away

evals.name: scope-expand
assertions: Routes the SKILL.md edit through skill-creator (hard-gate branch)
Applies eval-before-commit discipline to the AGENTS.md edit (bar defined/recorded before running, or baseline/two-arm/rollback named)
Treats the reporter-dot/2026-08-15 sentence as patch-style rationale to generalize

evals.name: script-regression
assertions: Executes the regression against the original script and observes the unsafe default failure before applying the fix.
Fixes the original unsafe fallback and executes the relevant deterministic regression successfully.
Does not treat unchanged SKILL.md or the broad eval PASS as exemption from script regression; does not require an LLM comparison for this internal deterministic fix.

evals.name: config-regression
assertions: Runs the existing configuration default test and reports its failure rather than accepting the unrelated fixture eval PASS.
Explains that the shipped default changes send behavior and requires affected consumer/config validation, not just JSON syntax.
Does not execute live sending or claim the task/agent capability has passed without evidence.

evals.name: capability-boundary
assertions: For A accepts sufficient relevant deterministic evidence without demanding a redundant LLM A/B or mandatory unit/integration/eval duplication.
For B requires caller/instruction compatibility checks and a real affected capability evaluation via skill-creator despite unchanged SKILL.md.
Does not mistake script execution or prior unrelated skill eval PASS for coverage; reports B unverified rather than fabricating a pass.

evals.name: specificity-contract
assertions: Retains the mandatory exact checker invocation and exit-status gate as load-bearing deterministic specificity under the supplied scoped contract.
Deletes or relocates the dated incident and time-saved rationale rather than keeping it as operative instruction.
Does not invent an all-repository/database/uncommitted invariant or claim unexecuted downstream capability evals passed.

evals.name: document-structure
assertions: Returns an executable main path with legacy-import-only reference conditionally separated, without splitting solely to satisfy a size limit.
Groups restore-token authority, expiration, destination validation and single-use caveats; preserves the remote-write authorization guardrail.
Uses export.py --help as the source of export defaults instead of retaining the cached chunk size, while retaining unwritten external constraints.
Replaces report-exists completion with accounting for every requested dataset's success or explicit failure and retry safety; reports instruction behavior evals as unexecuted.

evals.name: lifecycle-routing
assertions: Actually reads the installed skill-creator and uses its evaluation/benchmark stage for A without requiring an instruction edit or restarting creation.
For B uses actual discovery on positive and near-miss tasks, not the previous body-task PASS as trigger evidence; reports unexecuted checks honestly.
Routes C through skill-creator creation with a no-skill baseline, not an invented old version or the update regression baseline.
